description: Expenditure and service level data for water supply systems and sanitation facilities in Burkina Faso is a data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. This folder contains expenditure and service level data for water supply systems and sanitation facilities in Burkina Faso. Additionally a sample of the survey tools used to collect this data are provided. Data was collected in nine rural and peri-urban service areas spanning three regions of Burkina Faso: Centre, Haute-Bassins and Nord. Coverage: Burkina Faso. The portal files it under the publisher DANS Data Station Social Sciences and Humanities. Its tags are Business and Management, Social Sciences, Life-cycle costs, Water supply, Sanitation. The repository dates the deposit 2013; no later update was checked. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Zero v1.0 Universal. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water supply and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
